questions.question: When merging onto a freeway, what should you do?

options.text: Go slowly and wait for an opening.
Speed up faster than the traffic around you.
Turn on your hazard lights until you are safely on the freeway.
Speed up to match the freeway traffic speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Speed up to match the freeway traffic speed.
questions.explanation: Use the on-ramp to speed up and match the freeway traffic speed. This helps you blend in smoothly and safely. You must yield to traffic already on the freeway.

questions.question: How long can you drive in a center turn lane?
questions.explanation: You can travel up to 200 feet in a center turn lane before turning left. After you turn left onto the road, you can travel up to 50 feet in the center turn lane before merging with traffic.

questions.question: What color are signs for public recreation areas?
questions.explanation: Brown signs show cultural sites, historical areas, and public recreation areas. They are helpful when traveling to unfamiliar places.

questions.question: Cars begin to lose traction and hydroplane at 70 mph.
questions.explanation: On wet roads, cars can lose traction and hydroplane at speeds as low as 35 mph. When this happens, you lose control of your vehicle. Slow down when driving in rain.

questions.question: How long does it take a fully loaded tractor-trailer to stop at 55 mph?
questions.explanation: Large trucks take much longer to stop than small cars at the same speed. A fully loaded tractor-trailer needs about 400 feet to stop when traveling at 55 mph.

questions.question: When parking uphill on a curbed hill, which way should you turn your front wheels?

options.text: Turn them sharply toward the curb.
Turn them slightly to the right.
Turn them sharply away from the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn them sharply away from the curb.
questions.explanation: Turn your front wheels sharply away from the curb when parking uphill. This stops your car from rolling into traffic if it starts to roll. On roads without curbs, turn your wheels toward the edge of the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. Railroad tracks cross the road at a steep angle, and the bottom of low vehicles may scrape or catch on the tracks.

questions.question: When passing a vehicle that just parked on the road, what should you assume?

options.text: The driver will open the car door as you pass.
The driver will wait for you to pass before opening the door.

questions.correctAnswerText: The driver will open the car door as you pass.
questions.explanation: Assume the driver will open their door as you approach a parked car. Be extra careful when driving near parked vehicles.

questions.question: When entering the street from a driveway, what must you do?

options.text: Drive slowly to give vehicles and pedestrians time to move.
Honk your horn so vehicles and pedestrians will move.
Stop and only go when no pedestrians or vehicles are coming.
You can ignore pedestrians if there is no sidewalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and only go when no pedestrians or vehicles are coming.
questions.explanation: Always stop before entering the road from a driveway. Yield to any vehicles or pedestrians. Stop before crossing the sidewalk. Failing to stop is against the law.

questions.question: What does a broken yellow line next to a solid yellow line mean?

options.text: Passing on the left is allowed from either direction.
Passing is allowed from the lane with the broken line.
Passing is allowed from the lane with the solid line.
Passing is not allowed from either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Passing is allowed from the lane with the broken line.
questions.explanation: A broken yellow line next to a solid yellow line means you can pass from the side with the broken line.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital is to the right.

questions.question: What is the most important thing to remember about managing speed on curves?

options.text: Drive at the speed limit as you enter the curve, then slow down at the sharpest part.
Slow down before you enter the curve.
Speed up gently before you enter the curve.
Drive at the speed limit before, during, and after the curve.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down before you enter the curve.
questions.explanation: Slow down before entering a curve. Your vehicle's momentum can make it hard to turn. Slowing down first helps you stay in control.

questions.question: How should you think about railroad crossings?

options.text: They are safe to cross because trains rarely come.
They are safe places to park.
You must stop at every one.

questions.explanation: Railroad crossings are always dangerous. Look and listen for trains from both directions. Follow all signs, signals, and directions from flaggers. Never cross until you are sure it is safe.

questions.question: What lights should you use when driving in fog?

options.text: It does not matter which lights you use.

questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights when driving in fog, rain, or snow.

questions.question: Which statement about winter driving is false?

options.text: Winter is the hardest season to drive in.
Check your antifreeze and windshield washer fluid in winter.
Using cruise control in winter weather is safe.
Snow tires are the best choice for winter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Using cruise control in winter weather is safe.
questions.explanation: Do not use cruise control on snow, rain, fog, or other hazardous conditions. Winter driving is difficult and requires extra care. Check antifreeze and washer fluid levels regularly. Snow tires improve traction on slippery roads.

questions.question: Talking or texting on a cell phone while driving does not greatly increase your crash risk.
questions.explanation: Using a phone while driving distracts you and increases your risk of a crash.

questions.question: Which light tells you to slow down and proceed with caution?
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down, proceed with caution, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: When driving in fog, you should use your high beam headlights.
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights in fog. High beams reflect off the fog and can blind you.

questions.question: Guide signs are ____ signs that show directions and distances.
questions.explanation: Guide signs have a green background and show directions and distances to destinations. They help drivers find their way in unfamiliar areas.

questions.question: When should you allow more space in front of your vehicle than usual?
questions.explanation: Leave extra space when stopped on an uphill slope. If the vehicle ahead rolls backward when traffic starts, extra space reduces the chance of a crash.

questions.question: A single broken yellow line in the center of a two-lane road means:

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions. Drivers cannot pass.
Traffic moves in opposite directions. Drivers can pass when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction. Drivers cannot pass.
Traffic moves in the same direction. Drivers can pass when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in opposite directions. Drivers can pass when safe.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. A broken line means drivers can pass when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: On city streets, signal before turning ____ feet.
questions.explanation: Signal at least 100 feet before you turn on city streets. Keep signaling until you finish the turn or lane change.

questions.question: If a traffic light shows red and a green arrow at the same time, you cannot turn in the direction of the arrow until the red light changes.
questions.explanation: You can turn in the direction of a green arrow after yielding to traffic and pedestrians in the intersection. Other lights do not stop you.

questions.question: When turning left onto a one-way street, complete the turn into:

options.text: The lane closest to where you came from.

questions.correctAnswerText: The lane closest to where you came from.
questions.explanation: Always turn into the lane closest to your previous lane.

questions.question: If a green arrow changes to a solid green light, you:

options.text: Can still turn, but must yield to oncoming traffic.
Can no longer turn and must go straight.
Still have the right-of-way to turn.
No longer need to turn in the arrow's direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Can still turn, but must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: A solid green light means you can still turn in the direction the arrow was pointing. However, you must first yield to pedestrians and oncoming traffic.

questions.question: When visibility is reduced, your first action should be:
questions.explanation: Reduce your speed first when visibility is poor or road conditions are dangerous.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low overhead clearance. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: Which is a safe way to drive through a curve?

options.text: Slow down entering, speed up exiting.
Speed up entering, slow down exiting.
Stay near the right edge of your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down entering, speed up exiting.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you enter a curve and gradually speed up as you exit. Speeding up in a curve makes it harder to control your vehicle.

questions.question: A flashing red traffic light means:

options.text: Drivers must stop until the light turns green.
Drivers must slow down and proceed carefully.
It means the same thing as a stop sign.
Drivers should quickly clear the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: It means the same thing as a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light is like a stop sign. Come to a complete stop and proceed only when the road is clear.

questions.question: When parallel parking, park within ____ inches of the curb.
questions.explanation: Your wheels should be within 18 inches of the curb when parallel parking. Park only where it does not block traffic and your vehicle is clearly visible.
